text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I ran...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I fought fair and square in a high-level 
race... and got results.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Without thinking about limits... I seized 
it with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...At this rate, might we actually make 
it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A dream to sparkle...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...More. Even more—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I want to get closer to that sparkle...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The final Arima Kinen of the Senior Year. 
Before that, I want to run one more race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I want more confidence. I want a 
victory I seized after truly steeling 
myself to take 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want to truly believe in myself, be 
fully satisfied... and run the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nice Nature of before would have 
sought 'acceptance' out of a lack of 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, right now, she seeks even 
greater strength—all 'in order to win.'"
choice_data_list:
Back-to-back might be tough, are you 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm sure everything will be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
After all, Nature-san's best quality is 
her gritty, down-and-dirty running style.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll never use stamina or fatigue as an 
excuse. So... got it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll leave where we run up to you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm passing off all the messy overthinking 
to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at past trends and considering the 
time remaining until the Arima Kinen, the 
race to choose right now is—
choice_data_list: How about the Chunichi Shimbun Hai?
How about the Chunichi Shimbun Hai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The grade is lower, but it's a race where 
Nice Nature can get results. We can 
definitely aim for 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. The Chunichi Shimbun Hai... 
I'll take 1st place there.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll win and stand proud when I challenge 
her...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what should I get as my reward 
today? Fried fish cakes sound pretty nice~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the racecourse behind, we stopped 
by the usual shopping street at Nice 
Nature's request—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hum hum humm♪ Hmm hum humm♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, it's Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Teio...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, going out with your Trainer? Look at 
you two, so close♪"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, no, the race is totally over, though.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Good work today~! I just got 
back from karaoke!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nature, you've gotta practice for the 
concert properly too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you know that's my weak spot--

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hum hum humm♪ Hmm hum humm humm♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...! That song...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—The song for the upcoming "Arima Kinen." 
I've got to make sure I memorize it 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The culmination of the Senior Class! 
There's no way I'm gonna miss out on this!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No one but me could possibly stand at 
center stage. No matter who my opponent 
is!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...As expected, she's only looking 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're planning on running too, right, 
Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...? You knew?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Nature's been doing pretty well lately. 
Wagahai leaves no stone unturned when it 
comes to gathering intel!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I... see. Teio thinks that of me...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, Nature. Tell me."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Are you... ready to stake everything on 
beating me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I'm constantly 
surpassing myself. If you challenge me 
half-heartedly, it won't even be a 
contest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's because this stage gathers the 
greatest rivals, and because I will 
overwhelmingly defeat them here... that it 
has meaning.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll ask you one more time. ...Do you 
honestly think you can beat me as I am 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...That is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
—There's no way our Ne-chan would ever 
lose!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, huh? Mister...? Wait, 
everyone!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it, a large crowd of people 
from the shopping district had 
gathered..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Why are you staying quiet, Nat-chan?! This 
young lady is provoking you!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text:
"Where's that feistiness you usually use 
to put us in our place?! Come on, tell 'em 
you're not gonna lose!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, this is totally different from 
haggling over prices!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter what everyone else 
thinks, Nature. How do you feel about it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh... ngh. Th-That is...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine, Ne-chan! You've gotten 
stronger! The way you are now, you won't 
lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
We've got your back, Nei-chan! You don't 
have a thing to be afraid of!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu... Uuu~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text: Knock 'em dead, Naticha-n!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Aaargh...!! Jeez!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —I'm gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat you and shine brightly 
too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, sounds good. Your resolve has 
reached me loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This is gonna be a hundred times more 
interesting than I thought. —I've got high 
hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: “......Ahahaha. Haa....”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I totally said it~~~~....!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Nice Nature's anguished cry echoed into 
the evening sky...
